title: My Daughter-in-Law Said Count The Silverware Before The Homeless Man Leaves #Shorts
description:
My daughter-in-law told me to count the silverware before the homeless young man at our Thanksgiving table left. So I did. Out loud.

Who showed up for you when nobody else did? Tell me in the comments.
